home.title: Import listings
home.subtitle: Get the data, check it, then add new companies, update existing ones and reject bad records.
home.notFound: No import yet. Start with "New import" — a dry run first is recommended.

action.publishConfirm: Publish {{ count }} draft listings to the website now?
action.undoConfirm: Undo: {{ merged }} listings return to their old values, {{ created }} new listings go back to draft and leave the website. Fields changed after this import are kept.
action.importConfirm: Import to system: {{ created }} new listings go live, {{ merged }} listings get updated. Suspected duplicates stay for review.
action.importAgain: Import for real with this file

new.title: New import
new.fileHint: .xlsx or .csv (UTF-8) file, up to 100 MB. The first row holds column names (Vietnamese or English). See the template for all 28 columns.
new.badType: Only .xlsx or .csv files (old .xls: open in Excel and save as .xlsx).
new.dryRun: Dry run — classify only, write nothing to listings
new.dryRunHelp: Run a dry run first: check created / merged / suspected counts and row notes, then import for real.
new.realRunWarning: Real import: new listings are created as drafts (not on the website yet), duplicates get their empty fields filled.

api.sourceHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes. Stored on listings as api:<code>. Re-importing the same source matches the same records.
api.itemsPath: Path to the array of companies
api.itemsPathHelp: Dotted, e.g. data.items. Empty if the root JSON is an array.
api.headersHelp: One per line: Name: value (e.g. X-API-Key: …).
api.fieldMappingHelp: When JSON keys differ from standard names. One per line: standard name = path in item (e.g. taxCode = mst).
api.invalidSource: Source code may only contain lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
api.invalidUrl: URL must start with http:// or https://

new.directusHint: 1. Pull data into the holding table; live data is not touched. 2. Check data: review each tab, nothing is written. 3. Press Import for real on the result page.

directus.fullHelp: Fetch all 1.47 million records again (about 25 minutes); catches changes the source did not date. Do it periodically, e.g. monthly.

list.running: Running import #{{ id }} · {{ count }} rows processed · {{ duration }}

statusHelp.SUSPECT: Name close to an existing listing (with phone / address) — needs review
statusHelp.CREATED: No duplicate → new listing, as draft
statusHelp.MERGED: Certain duplicate (tax code / source id) → empty fields filled
statusHelp.DUPLICATE_IN_BATCH: Same as an earlier row in the same file

pull.unfinished: The full fetch at {{ at }} did not finish (stopped after {{ read }} records).
pull.RUNNING: Running {{ mode }}: {{ read }} records read, {{ changed }} new or changed.
pull.DONE: Last {{ mode }} ({{ at }}): {{ read }} records read, {{ changed }} new or changed.
pull.CANCELLED: {{ mode }} at {{ at }} was cancelled after {{ read }} records ({{ changed }} new or changed, saved).
pull.INTERRUPTED: {{ mode }} at {{ at }} was interrupted by a backend restart after {{ read }} records ({{ changed }} new or changed, saved).
pull.FAILED: {{ mode }} at {{ at }} failed after {{ read }} records:

steps.pullHelp: Saved to a holding table; live data is not touched. Get new data: only new and changed companies, a few minutes. Get everything: about 25 minutes, do it periodically.
steps.checkHelp: Compare with the system: new companies are added, existing ones updated, bad records rejected. Nothing is written yet.
steps.importHelp: After the check, the numbers appear here for you to confirm.
steps.lastImport: Last import: {{ created }} added, {{ merged }} updated, {{ rejected }} rejected.

detail.title: Import #{{ id }}
detail.dryRunNotice: This was a dry run: results show what WOULD happen; nothing was written. Import the file again without "Dry run" to write.
detail.runningNotice: Processing… this page updates itself. You can leave; the import keeps running.
detail.dryRunReady: This is a check result; nothing was written. Review each tab, then press Import to system at the top.
detail.cancelled: This import was cancelled. Unprocessed records stay in the holding table; run it again to continue.
detail.undoing: Undoing this import… this page updates itself.
detail.undone: Undone by {{ user }} at {{ at }}. {{ skipped }} fields were kept because they changed after this import. API records are marked not imported and can be imported again.
detail.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, tax code, source id
detail.doneNotice: Imported into the system: {{ created }} new listings, {{ merged }} listings updated.
detail.allPublished: New listings are live on the website.
detail.suspectNotice: {{ count }} suspected duplicates waiting for review.

review.title: Compare
review.mergeHelp: Fill empty fields of the existing listing, never overwrite
review.dryRunBlocked: Dry-run rows cannot be reviewed — import for real first.
